opponents.name: Engineer Allan
opponents.meet_text: As you can see, the new bulb installation went perrrrfectly today. I'm worn out from all the steps but always game for a match.
opponents.repeat_text: I won't be needing to replace the bulb any time soon so I've got time to kill.
opponents.first_win_text: That was clearly toooooo many steps today.
opponents.rematch_win_text: At least I'm reaaallly good at replacing bulbs.
opponents.loss_text: I hope your loss didn't come as a shock to you.

opponents.name: Gardener Callum
opponents.meet_text: Wowee, it was a long day gardening today. I'm down for a match to let off some steam now.
opponents.repeat_text: I've got time for a rematch before my next shift.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm clearly too worn out from such a long shift.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll win when I'm fully rested.
opponents.loss_text: Even after a hard days work I can still win!

opponents.name: Beach Kid Timothy
opponents.meet_text: I love the beach! I love the sand! I love building sandcastles! I love playing the Pokemon TCG!
opponents.repeat_text: I could build sandcastles and play Pokemon all day!
opponents.rematch_win_text: You can help me build a sandcastle if you want!

opponents.name: Beach Kid Evie
opponents.meet_text: I heard there's a scary Pokemon called Sandyghast. They sound scary and I don't like scary Pokemon, I only like cute pokemon!!
opponents.first_win_text: You haven't seen a Sandyghast have you?
opponents.rematch_win_text: If you see a Sandyghast please let me know!!

opponents.name: Sailor Bob
opponents.meet_text: I'm all done preparing for the arrival of the SS Anne so there's not much to do now until morning.
opponents.repeat_text: There's still time before the SS Anne arrives.
opponents.first_win_text: I should at least pretend to do some work on the dock.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I won't have a lot of time to play when the ship docks.
opponents.loss_text: All this spare time has given me a chance to practice.

opponents.name: Aromagirl Penelope
opponents.meet_text: Plants can grow in all weird shapes and sizes, they're not just flowers and trees, there's a lot of different kinds out there.
opponents.repeat_text: I've catalogued a lot of crazy plants recently.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I could do with some water

opponents.name: Bug Catcher Frankie
opponents.meet_text: Wow!!! The bugs here are so much cooler than what we have over in Viridian Forest!!
opponents.repeat_text: Seen any cool bug Pokemon around here since our last match?
opponents.first_win_text: My bugs clearly aren't as strong as the ones around here.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Hmm I wish I could get my hands on some of these bugs instead.
opponents.loss_text: Bug pokemon really aren't as weak as people think.

opponents.name: Guitarist Jonesy
opponents.meet_text: We're in a band and we're currently touring. We're just passing through to our next gig so having a quick jam here.
opponents.first_win_text: Damn I snapped a string while we were jamming.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You should come to one of our gigs!

opponents.name: Guitarist Howard
opponents.meet_text: We're the Toxtricity Rockers, we're a duo that's pretty big in Johto.
opponents.repeat_text: You here to hear a song or a rematch?
opponents.loss_text: If it's any consolation I'll give you a discount on our album.
